description: This file defines the SimliVideoService class, a Python source file implementing a real-time avatar video generation service using the Simli API. It manages audio/video processing, connection handling, and session parameters for avatar rendering.

classes.name: SimliVideoService
classes.description: A class for managing real-time avatar video generation via the Simli API, handling audio/video streams, connection lifecycle, and session parameters.

classes.name: SimliVideoService.InputParams
classes.description: A Pydantic model class for configuring input parameters such as logging, session length, and idle time.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Simli video service with API credentials, configuration, and session parameters.

methods.name: _start_connection
methods.description: Establishes connection to the Simli service and starts audio/video processing tasks.

methods.name: _consume_and_process_audio
methods.description: Consumes audio stream from Simli, resamples, and pushes audio frames downstream.

methods.name: _consume_and_process_video
methods.description: Consumes video stream from Simli, converts frames, and pushes them downstream.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, manages audio/video data, and controls connection lifecycle.

methods.name: _stop
methods.description: Stops the Simli client and cancels ongoing audio/video tasks.
